          fileType: "code",
          publicHrefPath: "posts/Shader-GLSL/006/js/index.js",
          codeText: "import * as THREE from 'three';\nlet scene, camera, renderer, geometry, material, plane, vShader, fShader;\n\nmain();\n\nfunction loadShaders() {\n    const vertexShaderPromise = fetch('glsl/vertexShader.glsl')\n        .then(response => response.text())\n        .then(data => {\n            vShader = data; // 将加载的顶点着色器源码赋给 vShader\n        });\n\n    const fragmentShaderPromise = fetch('glsl/fragmentShader.glsl')\n        .then(response => response.text())\n        .then(data => {\n            fShader = data; // 将加载的片段着色器源码赋给 fShader\n        });\n\n    // 使用 Promise.all 等待两个 Promise 都完成\n    return Promise.all([vertexShaderPromise, fragmentShaderPromise]);\n}\n\nfunction main() {\n    scene = new THREE.Scene();\n    camera = new THREE.OrthographicCamera(-1, 1, 1, -1, 0.1, 10);\n\n    renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer();\n    renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);\n    document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);\n\n    geometry = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(2, 2);\n\n    loadShaders().then(() => {\n        material = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({ vertexShader: vShader, fragmentShader: fShader });  // 应用顶点着色器和片元着色器\n\n        plane = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, material);\n        scene.add(plane);\n\n        camera.position.z = 1;\n\n        onWindowResize();\n\n        window.addEventListener('resize', onWindowResize, false);\n\n        animate();\n    }).catch(error => console.error('Error loading shaders:', error));\n\n}\n\nfunction onWindowResize(event) {\n    const aspectRatio = window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight;\n    let width, height;\n    if (aspectRatio >= 1) {\n        width = 1;\n        height = (window.innerHeight / window.innerWidth) * width;\n    } else {\n        width = aspectRatio;\n        height = 1;\n    }\n    camera.left = -width;\n    camera.right = width;\n    camera.top = height;\n    camera.bottom = -height;\n    camera.updateProjectionMatrix();\n    renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);\n}\n\nfunction animate() {\n    requestAnimationFrame(animate);\n    renderer.render(scene, camera);\n}",

// 将加载的顶点着色器源码赋给 vShader\n        });\n\n    const fragmentShaderPromise = fetch('glsl/fragmentShader.glsl')\n        .then(response => response.text())\n        .then(data => {\n            fShader = data; // 将加载的片段着色器源码赋给 fShader\n        });\n\n    // 使用 Promise.all 等待两个 Promise 都完成\n    return Promise.all([vertexShaderPromise, fragmentShaderPromise]);\n}\n\nfunction main() {\n    scene = new THREE.Scene();\n    camera = new THREE.OrthographicCamera(-1, 1, 1, -1, 0.1, 10);\n\n    renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer();\n    renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);\n    document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);\n\n    geometry = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(2, 2);\n\n    const uniforms = { u_color: { value: new THREE.Color(0x00FF00) } };  // 定义 uniform 变量\n\n    loadShaders().then(() => {\n        material = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({ uniforms: uniforms, vertexShader: vShader, fragmentShader: fShader });  // 应用顶点着色器和片元着色器\n\n        plane = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, material);\n        scene.add(plane);\n\n        camera.position.z = 1;\n\n        onWindowResize();\n\n        window.addEventListener('resize', onWindowResize, false);\n\n        animate();\n    }).catch(error => console.error('Error loading shaders:', error));\n\n}\n\nfunction onWindowResize(event) {\n    const aspectRatio = window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight;\n    let width, height;\n    if (aspectRatio >= 1) {\n        width = 1;\n        height = (window.innerHeight / window.innerWidth) * width;\n    } else {\n        width = aspectRatio;\n        height = 1;\n    }\n    camera.left = -width;\n    camera.right = width;\n    camera.top = height;\n    camera.bottom = -height;\n    camera.updateProjectionMatrix();\n    renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);\n}\n\nfunction animate() {\n    requestAnimationFrame(animate);\n    renderer.render(scene, camera);\n}",

          codeText: "import * as THREE from 'three';\nlet scene, camera, renderer, geometry, material, plane, vShader, fShader, uniforms;\n\nmain();\n\nfunction loadShaders() {\n    const vertexShaderPromise = fetch('glsl/vertexShader.glsl')\n        .then(response => response.text())\n        .then(data => {\n            vShader = data; // 将加载的顶点着色器源码赋给 vShader\n        });\n\n    const fragmentShaderPromise = fetch('glsl/fragmentShader.glsl')\n        .then(response => response.text())\n        .then(data => {\n            fShader = data; // 将加载的片段着色器源码赋给 fShader\n        });\n\n    // 使用 Promise.all 等待两个 Promise 都完成\n    return Promise.all([vertexShaderPromise, fragmentShaderPromise]);\n}\n\nfunction main() {\n    scene = new THREE.Scene();\n    camera = new THREE.OrthographicCamera(-1, 1, 1, -1, 0.1, 10);\n\n    renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer();\n    renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);\n    document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);\n\n    geometry = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(2, 2);\n\n    uniforms = {\n        u_mouse: { value: { x: 0.0, y: 0.0 } },\n        u_resolution: { value: { x: 0.0, y: 0.0 } },\n    };\n\n    loadShaders().then(() => {\n\n        material = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({ uniforms: uniforms, vertexShader: vShader, fragmentShader: fShader });  // 应用顶点着色器和片元着色器\n\n        plane = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, material);\n        scene.add(plane);\n    }).catch(error => console.error('Error loading shaders:', error));\n\n    camera.position.z = 1;\n\n    onWindowResize();\n\n    if ('ontouchstart' in window) {\n        console.log('touch device detected');\n        document.addEventListener('touchmove', move);\n    } else {\n        console.log('resize detected');\n        window.addEventListener('resize', onWindowResize, false);\n        document.addEventListener('mousemove', move)\n    }\n\n    animate();\n\n}\n\nfunction move(evt) {\n    uniforms.u_mouse.value.x = (evt.touches ? evt.touches[0].clientX : evt.clientX);\n    uniforms.u_mouse.value.y = (evt.touches ? evt.touches[0].clientY : evt.clientY);\n}\n\nfunction onWindowResize(event) {\n    const aspectRatio = window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight;\n    let width, height;\n    if (aspectRatio >= 1) {\n        width = 1;\n        height = (window.innerHeight / window.innerWidth) * width;\n    } else {\n        width = aspectRatio;\n        height = 1;\n    }\n    camera.left = -width;\n    camera.right = width;\n    camera.top = height;\n    camera.bottom = -height;\n    camera.updateProjectionMatrix();\n    renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);\n\n    if (uniforms.u_resolution !== undefined) {\n        uniforms.u_resolution.value.x = window.innerWidth;\n        uniforms.u_resolution.value.y = window.innerHeight;\n    }\n}\n\nfunction animate() {\n    requestAnimationFrame(animate);\n    renderer.render(scene, camera);\n}",

          codeText: "import * as THREE from 'three';\nlet scene, camera, renderer, geometry, material, plane, vShader, fShader, uniforms, clock;\n\nmain();\n\nfunction loadShaders() {\n    const vertexShaderPromise = fetch('glsl/vertexShader.glsl')\n        .then(response => response.text())\n        .then(data => {\n            vShader = data; // 将加载的顶点着色器源码赋给 vShader\n        });\n\n    const fragmentShaderPromise = fetch('glsl/fragmentShader.glsl')\n        .then(response => response.text())\n        .then(data => {\n            fShader = data; // 将加载的片段着色器源码赋给 fShader\n        });\n\n    // 使用 Promise.all 等待两个 Promise 都完成\n    return Promise.all([vertexShaderPromise, fragmentShaderPromise]);\n}\n\nfunction main() {\n    scene = new THREE.Scene();\n    camera = new THREE.OrthographicCamera(-1, 1, 1, -1, 0.1, 10);\n\n    renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer();\n    renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);\n    document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);\n\n    clock = new THREE.Clock();\n    geometry = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(2, 2);\n\n    uniforms = {\n        u_time: { value: 0.0 },\n    };\n\n    loadShaders().then(() => {\n\n        material = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({ uniforms: uniforms, vertexShader: vShader, fragmentShader: fShader });  // 应用顶点着色器和片元着色器\n\n        plane = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, material);\n        scene.add(plane);\n    }).catch(error => console.error('Error loading shaders:', error));\n\n    camera.position.z = 1;\n\n    onWindowResize();\n\n    animate();\n\n}\n\nfunction onWindowResize(event) {\n    const aspectRatio = window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight;\n    let width, height;\n    if (aspectRatio >= 1) {\n        width = 1;\n        height = (window.innerHeight / window.innerWidth) * width;\n    } else {\n        width = aspectRatio;\n        height = 1;\n    }\n    camera.left = -width;\n    camera.right = width;\n    camera.top = height;\n    camera.bottom = -height;\n    camera.updateProjectionMatrix();\n    renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);\n}\n\nfunction animate() {\n    requestAnimationFrame(animate);\n    uniforms.u_time.value += clock.getDelta();  // clock.getElapsedTime(); 如果选这个会闪瞎狗眼\n    renderer.render(scene, camera);\n}",

          codeText: "import * as THREE from 'three';\nlet scene, camera, renderer, geometry, material, plane, vShader, fShader, uniforms, clock;\n\nmain();\n\nfunction loadShaders() {\n    const vertexShaderPromise = fetch('glsl/vertexShader.glsl')\n        .then(response => response.text())\n        .then(data => {\n            vShader = data; // 将加载的顶点着色器源码赋给 vShader\n        });\n\n    const fragmentShaderPromise = fetch('glsl/fragmentShader.glsl')\n        .then(response => response.text())\n        .then(data => {\n            fShader = data; // 将加载的片段着色器源码赋给 fShader\n        });\n\n    // 使用 Promise.all 等待两个 Promise 都完成\n    return Promise.all([vertexShaderPromise, fragmentShaderPromise]);\n}\n\nfunction main() {\n    scene = new THREE.Scene();\n    camera = new THREE.OrthographicCamera(-1, 1, 1, -1, 0.1, 10);\n\n    renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer();\n    renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);\n    document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);\n\n    clock = new THREE.Clock();\n    geometry = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(2, 2);\n\n    uniforms = {\n        u_resolution: { value: { x: 0.0, y: 0.0 } },\n    };\n\n    loadShaders().then(() => {\n\n        material = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({ uniforms: uniforms, vertexShader: vShader, fragmentShader: fShader });  // 应用顶点着色器和片元着色器\n\n        plane = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, material);\n        scene.add(plane);\n    }).catch(error => console.error('Error loading shaders:', error));\n\n    camera.position.z = 1;\n\n    onWindowResize();\n    window.addEventListener('resize', onWindowResize, false);\n\n    animate();\n\n}\n\nfunction onWindowResize(event) {\n    const aspectRatio = window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight;\n    let width, height;\n    if (aspectRatio >= 1) {\n        width = 1;\n        height = (window.innerHeight / window.innerWidth) * width;\n    } else {\n        width = aspectRatio;\n        height = 1;\n    }\n    camera.left = -width;\n    camera.right = width;\n    camera.top = height;\n    camera.bottom = -height;\n    camera.updateProjectionMatrix();\n    renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);\n\n    if (uniforms.u_resolution !== undefined) {\n        uniforms.u_resolution.value.x = window.innerWidth;\n        uniforms.u_resolution.value.y = window.innerHeight;\n    }\n}\n\nfunction animate() {\n    requestAnimationFrame(animate);\n    renderer.render(scene, camera);\n}",

          codeText: "import * as THREE from 'three';\nlet scene, camera, renderer, geometry, material, plane, vShader, fShader, uniforms, clock;\n\nmain();\n\nfunction loadShaders() {\n    const vertexShaderPromise = fetch('glsl/vertexShader.glsl')\n        .then(response => response.text())\n        .then(data => {\n            vShader = data; // 将加载的顶点着色器源码赋给 vShader\n        });\n\n    const fragmentShaderPromise = fetch('glsl/fragmentShader.glsl')\n        .then(response => response.text())\n        .then(data => {\n            fShader = data; // 将加载的片段着色器源码赋给 fShader\n        });\n\n    // 使用 Promise.all 等待两个 Promise 都完成\n    return Promise.all([vertexShaderPromise, fragmentShaderPromise]);\n}\n\nfunction main() {\n    scene = new THREE.Scene();\n    camera = new THREE.OrthographicCamera(-1, 1, 1, -1, 0.1, 10);\n\n    renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer();\n    renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);\n    document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);\n\n    clock = new THREE.Clock();\n    geometry = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(2, 2);\n\n    uniforms = {\n        u_resolution: { value: { x: 0.0, y: 0.0 } },\n    };\n\n    loadShaders().then(() => {\n\n        material = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({ uniforms: uniforms, vertexShader: vShader, fragmentShader: fShader });  // 应用顶点着色器和片元着色器\n\n        plane = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, material);\n        scene.add(plane);\n    }).catch(error => console.error('Error loading shaders:', error));\n\n    camera.position.z = 1;\n\n    onWindowResize();\n    window.addEventListener('resize', onWindowResize, false);\n\n    animate();\n\n}\n\nfunction onWindowResize(event) {\n    const aspectRatio = window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight;\n    let width, height;\n    if (aspectRatio >= 1) {\n        width = 1;\n        height = (window.innerHeight / window.innerWidth) * width;\n    } else {\n        width = aspectRatio;\n        height = 1;\n    }\n    camera.left = -width;\n    camera.right = width;\n    camera.top = height;\n    camera.bottom = -height;\n    camera.updateProjectionMatrix();\n    renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);\n\n    if (uniforms.u_resolution !== undefined) {\n        uniforms.u_resolution.value.x = window.innerWidth;\n        uniforms.u_resolution.value.y = window.innerHeight;\n    }\n}\n\nfunction animate() {\n    requestAnimationFrame(animate);\n    renderer.render(scene, camera);\n}",

          codeText: "import * as THREE from 'three';\nlet scene, camera, renderer, geometry, material, plane, vShader, fShader, uniforms, clock;\n\nmain();\n\nfunction loadShaders() {\n    const vertexShaderPromise = fetch('glsl/vertexShader.glsl')\n        .then(response => response.text())\n        .then(data => {\n            vShader = data; // 将加载的顶点着色器源码赋给 vShader\n        });\n\n    const fragmentShaderPromise = fetch('glsl/fragmentShader.glsl')\n        .then(response => response.text())\n        .then(data => {\n            fShader = data; // 将加载的片段着色器源码赋给 fShader\n        });\n\n    // 使用 Promise.all 等待两个 Promise 都完成\n    return Promise.all([vertexShaderPromise, fragmentShaderPromise]);\n}\n\nfunction main() {\n    scene = new THREE.Scene();\n    camera = new THREE.OrthographicCamera(-1, 1, 1, -1, 0.1, 10);\n\n    renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer();\n    renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);\n    document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);\n\n    clock = new THREE.Clock();\n    geometry = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(2, 2);\n\n    uniforms = {\n        u_resolution: { value: { x: 0.0, y: 0.0 } },\n        u_time: { value: 0.0 },\n    };\n\n    loadShaders().then(() => {\n\n        material = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({ uniforms: uniforms, vertexShader: vShader, fragmentShader: fShader });  // 应用顶点着色器和片元着色器\n\n        plane = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, material);\n        scene.add(plane);\n    }).catch(error => console.error('Error loading shaders:', error));\n\n    camera.position.z = 1;\n\n    onWindowResize();\n    window.addEventListener('resize', onWindowResize, false);\n\n    animate();\n\n}\n\nfunction onWindowResize(event) {\n    const aspectRatio = window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight;\n    let width, height;\n    if (aspectRatio >= 1) {\n        width = 1;\n        height = (window.innerHeight / window.innerWidth) * width;\n    } else {\n        width = aspectRatio;\n        height = 1;\n    }\n    camera.left = -width;\n    camera.right = width;\n    camera.top = height;\n    camera.bottom = -height;\n    camera.updateProjectionMatrix();\n    renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);\n\n    if (uniforms.u_resolution !== undefined) {\n        uniforms.u_resolution.value.x = window.innerWidth;\n        uniforms.u_resolution.value.y = window.innerHeight;\n    }\n}\n\nfunction animate() {\n    requestAnimationFrame(animate);\n    uniforms.u_time.value += clock.getDelta();\n    renderer.render(scene, camera);\n}",

          codeText: "import * as THREE from 'three';\nlet scene, camera, renderer, geometry, material, plane, vShader, fShader, uniforms, clock;\n\nmain();\n\nfunction loadShaders() {\n    const vertexShaderPromise = fetch('glsl/vertexShader.glsl')\n        .then(response => response.text())\n        .then(data => {\n            vShader = data; // 将加载的顶点着色器源码赋给 vShader\n        });\n\n    const fragmentShaderPromise = fetch('glsl/fragmentShader.glsl')\n        .then(response => response.text())\n        .then(data => {\n            fShader = data; // 将加载的片段着色器源码赋给 fShader\n        });\n\n    // 使用 Promise.all 等待两个 Promise 都完成\n    return Promise.all([vertexShaderPromise, fragmentShaderPromise]);\n}\n\nfunction main() {\n    scene = new THREE.Scene();\n    camera = new THREE.OrthographicCamera(-1, 1, 1, -1, 0.1, 10);\n\n    renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer();\n    renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);\n    document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);\n\n    clock = new THREE.Clock();\n    geometry = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(2, 2);\n\n    uniforms = {\n        u_resolution: { value: { x: 0.0, y: 0.0 } },\n        u_time: { value: 0.0 },\n    };\n\n    loadShaders().then(() => {\n\n        material = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({ uniforms: uniforms, vertexShader: vShader, fragmentShader: fShader });  // 应用顶点着色器和片元着色器\n\n        plane = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, material);\n        scene.add(plane);\n    }).catch(error => console.error('Error loading shaders:', error));\n\n    camera.position.z = 1;\n\n    onWindowResize();\n    window.addEventListener('resize', onWindowResize, false);\n\n    animate();\n\n}\n\nfunction onWindowResize(event) {\n    const aspectRatio = window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight;\n    let width, height;\n    if (aspectRatio >= 1) {\n        width = 1;\n        height = (window.innerHeight / window.innerWidth) * width;\n    } else {\n        width = aspectRatio;\n        height = 1;\n    }\n    camera.left = -width;\n    camera.right = width;\n    camera.top = height;\n    camera.bottom = -height;\n    camera.updateProjectionMatrix();\n    renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);\n\n    if (uniforms.u_resolution !== undefined) {\n        uniforms.u_resolution.value.x = window.innerWidth;\n        uniforms.u_resolution.value.y = window.innerHeight;\n    }\n}\n\nfunction animate() {\n    requestAnimationFrame(animate);\n    uniforms.u_time.value += clock.getDelta();\n    renderer.render(scene, camera);\n}",

// 将加载的顶点着色器源码赋给 vShader\n        });\n\n    const fragmentShaderPromise = fetch('glsl/fragmentShader.glsl')\n        .then(response => response.text())\n        .then(data => {\n            fShader = data; // 将加载的片段着色器源码赋给 fShader\n        });\n\n    // 使用 Promise.all 等待两个 Promise 都完成\n    return Promise.all([vertexShaderPromise, fragmentShaderPromise]);\n}\n\nfunction main() {\n    scene = new THREE.Scene();\n    camera = new THREE.OrthographicCamera(-1, 1, 1, -1, 0.1, 10);\n\n    renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer();\n    renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);\n    document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);\n\n    clock = new THREE.Clock();\n    geometry = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(2, 2);\n\n    uniforms = {\n        u_tex: { value: new THREE.TextureLoader().load(\"https://s3-us-west-2.amazonaws.com/s.cdpn.io/2666677/flame.png\") },\n        u_time: { value: 0.0 },\n    }\n\n    loadShaders().then(() => {\n\n        material = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({ uniforms: uniforms, vertexShader: vShader, fragmentShader: fShader });  // 应用顶点着色器和片元着色器\n\n        plane = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, material);\n        scene.add(plane);\n    }).catch(error => console.error('Error loading shaders:', error));\n\n    camera.position.z = 1;\n\n    onWindowResize();\n    window.addEventListener('resize', onWindowResize, false);\n\n    animate();\n\n}\n\nfunction onWindowResize(event) {\n    const aspectRatio = window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight;\n    let width, height;\n    if (aspectRatio >= 1) {\n        width = 1;\n        height = (window.innerHeight / window.innerWidth) * width;\n    } else {\n        width = aspectRatio;\n        height = 1;\n    }\n    camera.left = -width;\n    camera.right = width;\n    camera.top = height;\n    camera.bottom = -height;\n    camera.updateProjectionMatrix();\n    renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);\n}\n\nfunction animate() {\n    requestAnimationFrame(animate);\n    uniforms.u_time.value += clock.getDelta();\n    renderer.render(scene, camera);\n}",

          codeText: "import * as THREE from 'three';\nlet scene, camera, renderer, geometry, material, plane, vShader, fShader, uniforms, clock, noise;\n\nmain();\n\nfunction loadNoiseShader() {\n    const vertexShaderPromise = fetch('glsl/noise.glsl')\n        .then(response => response.text())\n        .then(data => {\n            noise = data;\n        });\n\n    return vertexShaderPromise;\n}\n\nfunction loadUniforms() {\n    const vertexShaderPromise = fetch('json/uniforms.json')\n        .then(response => response.text())\n        .then(data => {\n            uniforms = JSON.parse(data).uniforms;\n        });\n\n    return vertexShaderPromise;\n}\n\nfunction loadShaders() {\n    const vertexShaderPromise = fetch('glsl/vertexShader.glsl')\n        .then(response => response.text())\n        .then(data => {\n            vShader = data; // 将加载的顶点着色器源码赋给 vShader\n        });\n\n    const fragmentShaderPromise = fetch('glsl/fragmentShader.glsl')\n        .then(response => response.text())\n        .then(data => {\n            fShader = data; // 将加载的片段着色器源码赋给 fShader\n        });\n\n    // 使用 Promise.all 等待两个 Promise 都完成\n    return Promise.all([vertexShaderPromise, fragmentShaderPromise]);\n}\n\nfunction main() {\n    scene = new THREE.Scene();\n    camera = new THREE.OrthographicCamera(-1, 1, 1, -1, 0.1, 10);\n\n    renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer();\n    renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);\n    document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);\n\n    clock = new THREE.Clock();\n    geometry = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(2, 2);\n\n    THREE.ShaderChunk.simple_lambert_vertex = `\n\tvec3 vLightFront, vLightBack;\n\t#include <beginnormal_vertex>\n\t#include <defaultnormal_vertex>\n\t#include <begin_vertex>\n\t#include <project_vertex>\n\t#include <lights_lambert_vertex>`\n\n    loadNoiseShader().then(() => {\n        THREE.ShaderChunk.noise = noise;\n        loadUniforms().then(() => {\n            loadShaders().then(() => {\n                material = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({ uniforms: uniforms, vertexShader: vShader, fragmentShader: fShader });\n                plane = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, material);\n                scene.add(plane);\n            }).catch(error => console.error('Error loading shaders:', error));\n        }).catch(error => console.error('Error loading uniforms:', error));\n    }).catch(error => console.error('Error loading noise shader:', error));\n\n    camera.position.z = 1;\n\n    onWindowResize();\n    window.addEventListener('resize', onWindowResize, false);\n\n    animate();\n\n}\n\nfunction onWindowResize(event) {\n    const aspectRatio = window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight;\n    let width, height;\n    if (aspectRatio >= 1) {\n        width = 1;\n        height = (window.innerHeight / window.innerWidth) * width;\n    } else {\n        width = aspectRatio;\n        height = 1;\n    }\n    camera.left = -width;\n    camera.right = width;\n    camera.top = height;\n    camera.bottom = -height;\n    camera.updateProjectionMatrix();\n    renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);\n}\n\nfunction animate() {\n    requestAnimationFrame(animate);\n    renderer.render(scene, camera);\n}",

vec3(3.0, 3.0, 3.0)) / power);\n    }\n\n    return t;\n}\n\nfloat turbulence6(vec3 p) {\n    float w = 100.0;\n    float t = -.5;\n\n    for(float f = 1.0; f <= 6.0; f++) {\n        float power = pow(2.0, f);\n        t += abs(pnoise(vec3(power * p), vec3(6.0, 6.0, 6.0)) / power);\n    }\n\n    return t;\n}\n\n\t//\n\t// 2-D tiling simplex noise with rotating gradients and analytical derivative.\n\t// The first component of the 3-element return vector is the noise value,\n\t// and the second and third components are the x and y partial derivatives.\n\t//\nvec3 psrdnoise(vec2 pos, vec2 per, float rot) {\n\t  // Hack: offset y slightly to hide some rare artifacts\n    pos.y += 0.01;\n\t  // Skew to hexagonal grid\n    vec2 uv = vec2(pos.x + pos.y * 0.5, pos.y);\n\n    vec2 i0 = floor(uv);\n    vec2 f0 = fract(uv);\n\t  // Traversal order\n    vec2 i1 = (f0.x > f0.y) ? vec2(1.0, 0.0) : vec2(0.0, 1.0);\n\n\t  // Unskewed grid points in (x,y) space\n    vec2 p0 = vec2(i0.x - i0.y * 0.5, i0.y);\n    vec2 p1 = vec2(p0.x + i1.x - i1.y * 0.5, p0.y + i1.y);\n    vec2 p2 = vec2(p0.x + 0.5, p0.y + 1.0);\n\n\t  // Integer grid point indices in (u,v) space\n    i1 = i0 + i1;\n    vec2 i2 = i0 + vec2(1.0, 1.0);\n\n\t  // Vectors in unskewed (x,y) coordinates from\n\t  // each of the simplex corners to the evaluation point\n    vec2 d0 = pos - p0;\n    vec2 d1 = pos - p1;\n    vec2 d2 = pos - p2;\n\n\t  // Wrap i0, i1 and i2 to the desired period before gradient hashing:\n\t  // wrap points in (x,y), map to (u,v)\n    vec3 xw = mod(vec3(p0.x, p1.x, p2.x), per.x);\n    vec3 yw = mod(vec3(p0.y, p1.y, p2.y), per.y);\n    vec3 iuw = xw + 0.5 * yw;\n    vec3 ivw = yw;\n\n\t  // Create gradients from indices\n    vec2 g0 = rgrad2(vec2(iuw.x, ivw.x), rot);\n    vec2 g1 = rgrad2(vec2(iuw.y, ivw.y), rot);\n    vec2 g2 = rgrad2(vec2(iuw.z, ivw.z), rot);\n\n\t  // Gradients dot vectors to corresponding corners\n\t  // (The derivatives of this are simply the gradients)\n    vec3 w = vec3(dot(g0, d0), dot(g1, d1), dot(g2, d2));\n\n\t  // Radial weights from corners\n\t  // 0.8 is the square of 2/sqrt(5), the distance from\n\t  // a grid point to the nearest simplex boundary\n    vec3 t = 0.8 - vec3(dot(d0, d0), dot(d1, d1), dot(d2, d2));\n\n\t  // Partial derivatives for analytical gradient computation\n    vec3 dtdx = -2.0 * vec3(d0.x, d1.x, d2.x);\n    vec3 dtdy = -2.0 * vec3(d0.y, d1.y, d2.y);\n\n\t  // Set influence of each surflet to zero outside radius sqrt(0.8)\n    if(t.x < 0.0) {\n        dtdx.x = 0.0;\n        dtdy.x = 0.0;\n        t.x = 0.0;\n    }\n    if(t.y < 0.0) {\n        dtdx.y = 0.0;\n        dtdy.y = 0.0;\n        t.y = 0.0;\n    }\n    if(t.z < 0.0) {\n        dtdx.z = 0.0;\n        dtdy.z = 0.0;\n        t.z = 0.0;\n    }\n\n\t  // Fourth power of t (and third power for derivative)\n    vec3 t2 = t * t;\n    vec3 t4 = t2 * t2;\n    vec3 t3 = t2 * t;\n\n\t  // Final noise value is:\n\t  // sum of ((radial weights) times (gradient dot vector from corner))\n    float n = dot(t4, w);\n\n\t  // Final analytical derivative (gradient of a sum of scalar products)\n    vec2 dt0 = vec2(dtdx.x, dtdy.x) * 4.0 * t3.x;\n    vec2 dn0 = t4.x * g0 + dt0 * w.x;\n    vec2 dt1 = vec2(dtdx.y, dtdy.y) * 4.0 * t3.y;\n    vec2 dn1 = t4.y * g1 + dt1 * w.y;\n    vec2 dt2 = vec2(dtdx.z, dtdy.z) * 4.0 * t3.z;\n    vec2 dn2 = t4.z * g2 + dt2 * w.z;\n\n    return 11.0 * vec3(n, dn0 + dn1 + dn2);\n}\n\n\t//\n\t// 2-D tiling simplex noise with fixed gradients\n\t// and analytical derivative.\n\t// This function is implemented as a wrapper to \"psrdnoise\",\n\t// at the minimal cost of three extra additions.\n\t//\nvec3 psdnoise(vec2 pos, vec2 per) {\n    return psrdnoise(pos, per, 0.0);\n}\n\n\t//\n\t// 2-D tiling simplex noise with rotating gradients,\n\t// but without the analytical derivative.\n\t//\nfloat psrnoise(vec2 pos, vec2 per, float rot) {\n\t  // Offset y slightly to hide some rare artifacts\n    pos.y += vec2(p0.x + 0.5, p0.y + 1.0);\n\n\t  // Integer grid point indices in (u,v) space\n    i1 = i0 + i1;\n    vec2 i2 = i0 + vec2(1.0, 1.0);\n\n\t  // Vectors in unskewed (x,y) coordinates from\n\t  // each of the simplex corners to the evaluation point\n    vec2 d0 = pos - p0;\n    vec2 d1 = pos - p1;\n    vec2 d2 = pos - p2;\n\n\t  // Wrap i0, i1 and i2 to the desired period before gradient yw;\n\n\t  // Create gradients from indices\n    vec2 g0 = rgrad2(vec2(iuw.x, ivw.x), rot);\n    vec2 g1 = rgrad2(vec2(iuw.y, ivw.y), rot);\n    vec2 g2 = rgrad2(vec2(iuw.z, ivw.z), rot);\n\n\t  // influence of each surflet to zero outside radius sqrt(0.8)\n    t = max(t, 0.0);\n\n\t  // Fourth power of t\n    vec3 t2 = t * t;\n    vec3 t4 = t2 * t2;\n\n\t  // Final noise value is:\n\t  // sum of ((radial weights) times (gradient dot vector from corner))\n    float n = dot(t4, w);\n\n\t  // Rescale to cover the range [-1,1] reasonably well\n    return 11.0 * n;\n}\n\n\t//\n\t// 2-D tiling simplex noise with fixed gradients,\n\t// without the analytical derivative.\n\t// This function is implemented as a wrapper to \"psrnoise\",\n\t// at the minimal cost of three extra additions.\n\t//\nfloat psnoise(vec2 pos, vec2 per) {\n    return psrnoise(pos, per, 0.0);\n}\n\n\t//\n\t// 2-D non-tiling simplex noise with rotating gradients and analytical derivative.\n\t// The first component of the 3-element return vector is the noise value,\n\t// and the second and third components are the x and y partial derivatives.\n\t//\nvec3 srdnoise(vec2 pos, float rot) {\n\t  //           codeText: "import * as THREE from 'three';\nlet scene, camera, renderer, geometry, material, plane, vShader, fShader, uniforms, clock, noise;\n\nmain();\n\nfunction loadNoiseShader() {\n    const vertexShaderPromise = fetch('glsl/noise.glsl')\n        .then(response => response.text())\n        .then(data => {\n            noise = data;\n        });\n\n    return vertexShaderPromise;\n}\n\nfunction loadUniforms() {\n    const vertexShaderPromise = fetch('json/uniforms.json').then(response => response.json())  // 解析 JSON 数据\n        .then(data => {\n            uniforms = {\n                u_tex: { value: new THREE.TextureLoader().load(data.uniforms.u_tex.value) },\n                u_time: { value: data.uniforms.u_time.value },\n                u_mouse: { value: { x: data.uniforms.u_mouse.value.x, y: data.uniforms.u_mouse.value.y } },\n                u_resolution: { value: { x: data.uniforms.u_resolution.value.x, y: data.uniforms.u_resolution.value.y } }\n            };\n        });\n\n    return vertexShaderPromise;\n}\n\nfunction loadShaders() {\n    const vertexShaderPromise = fetch('glsl/vertexShader.glsl')\n        .then(response => response.text())\n        .then(data => {\n            vShader = data;\n        });\n\n    const fragmentShaderPromise = fetch('glsl/fragmentShader.glsl')\n        .then(response => response.text())\n        .then(data => {\n            fShader = data;\n        });\n\n    return Promise.all([vertexShaderPromise, fragmentShaderPromise]);\n}\n\nfunction main() {\n    scene = new THREE.Scene();\n    camera = new THREE.OrthographicCamera(-1, 1, 1, -1, 0.1, 10);\n\n    renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer();\n    renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);\n    document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);\n\n    clock = new THREE.Clock();\n    geometry = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(2, 2);\n\n    loadNoiseShader().then(() => {\n        THREE.ShaderChunk.noise = noise;\n        loadUniforms().then(() => {\n            loadShaders().then(() => {\n                material = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({ uniforms: uniforms, vertexShader: vShader, fragmentShader: fShader });\n                plane = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, material);\n                scene.add(plane);\n            }).catch(error => console.error('Error loading shaders:', error));\n        }).catch(error => console.error('Error loading uniforms:', error));\n    }).catch(error => console.error('Error loading noise shader:', error));\n\n    camera.position.z = 1;\n\n    onWindowResize();\n    window.addEventListener('resize', onWindowResize, false);\n\n    animate();\n\n}\n\nfunction onWindowResize(event) {\n    const aspectRatio = window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight;\n    let width, height;\n    if (aspectRatio >= 1) {\n        width = 1;\n        height = (window.innerHeight / window.innerWidth) * width;\n    } else {\n        width = aspectRatio;\n        height = 1;\n    }\n    camera.left = -width;\n    camera.right = width;\n    camera.top = height;\n    camera.bottom = -height;\n    camera.updateProjectionMatrix();\n    renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);\n}\n\nfunction animate() {\n    requestAnimationFrame(animate);\n    uniforms.u_time.value += clock.getDelta();\n    renderer.render(scene, camera);\n}",

taylorInvSqrt(vec4 r) {\n    return 1.79284291400159 - 0.85373472095314 * r;\n}\n\nvec2 fade(vec2 t) {\n    return t * t * t * (t * (t * 6.0 - 15.0) + 10.0);\n}\n\nvec3 fade(vec3 t) {\n    return t * t * t * (t * (t * 6.0 - 15.0) + 10.0);\n}\n\n\t// Hashed 2-D gradients with an extra rotation.\n\t// (The constant 0.0243902439 is 1/41)\nvec2 rgrad2(vec2 p, float rot) {\n\t#if 0\n\t// Map from a line to a diamond such that a shift maps to a rotation.\n    float u = permute(permute(p.x) + p.y) * 0.0243902439 + rot; // Rotate by shift\n    u = 4.0 * fract(u) - 2.0;\n\t  // (This vector could be permute(permute(p.x) + p.y) * 0.0243902439 + rot; // Rotate by shift\n    u = fract(u) * 6.28318530718; // 2*pi\n    return vec2(cos(u), sin(u));\n\t#endif\n}\n\nfloat snoise(vec3 v) {\n    const vec2 p3 *= norm.w;\n\n\t// Mix final noise value\n    vec4 m = max(0.6 - vec4(dot(x0, x0), dot(x1, x1), dot(x2, x2), dot(x3, x3)), 0.0);\n    m = m * m;\n    return 42.0 * dot(m * m, vec4(dot(p0, x0),    vec4 gy0 = fract(floor(gx0) * (1.0 / 7.0)) - 0.5;\n    gx0 = fract(gx0);\n    vec4 gz0 = vec4(0.5) - abs(gx0) - abs(gy0);\n    vec4 sz0 = step(gz0, vec4(0.0));\n    gx0 -= sz0 * (step(0.0, gx0) - 0.5);\n    gy0 -= sz0 * (step(0.0, gy0) - 0.5);\n\n    vec4 gx1 = ixy1 * (1.0 / 7.0);\n    vec4 gy1 = fract(floor(gx1) * (1.0 / 7.0)) - 0.5;\n    gx1 = fract(gx1);\n    vec4 gz1 = vec4(0.5) - abs(gx1) - abs(gy1);\n    vec4 sz1 = step(gz1, vec4(0.0));\n    gx1 -= sz1 * (step(0.0, gx1) - 0.5);\n    gy1 -= sz1 * (step(0.0, gy1) - 0.5);\n\n    vec3 g000 = vec3(gx0.x, gy0.x, gz0.x);\n    vec3 g100 = vec3(gx0.y, gy0.y, gz0.y);\n    vec3 g010 = vec3(gx0.z, gy0.z, gz0.z);\n    vec3 g110 = vec3(gx0.w, gy0.w, gz0.w);\n    vec3 g001 = vec3(gx1.x, gy1.x, gz1.x);\n    vec3 g101 = vec3(gx1.y, gy1.y, gz1.y);\n    vec3 g011 = vec3(gx1.z, gy1.z, gz1.z);\n    vec3 g111 = vec3(gx1.w, gy1.w, gz1.w);\n\n    vec4 norm0 = taylorInvSqrt(vec4(dot(g000, g000), dot(g010, g010), dot(g100, g100), dot(g110, g110)));\n    g000 *= norm0.x;\n    g010 *= norm0.y;\n    g100 *= norm0.z;\n    g110 *= norm0.w;\n    vec4 norm1 = taylorInvSqrt(vec4(dot(g001, g001), dot(g011, g011), dot(g101, g101), dot(g111, g111)));\n    g001 *= norm1.x;\n    g011 *= norm1.y;\n    g101 *= norm1.z;\n    g111 *= norm1.w;\n\n    float n000 = dot(g000, Pf0);\n    float n100 = dot(g100, vec3(Pf1.x, Pf0.yz));\n    float n010 = dot(g010, vec3(Pf0.x, Pf1.y, Pf0.z));\n    float n110 = dot(g110, vec3(Pf1.xy, Pf0.z));\n    float n001 = dot(g001, vec3(Pf0.xy, Pf1.z));\n    float n101 = dot(g101, vec3(Pf1.x, Pf0.y, Pf1.z));\n    float n011 = dot(g011, vec3(Pf0.x, Pf1.yz));\n    float n111 = dot(g111, Pf1);\n\n    vec3 fade_xyz = fade(Pf0);\n    vec4 n_z = mix(vec4(n000, n100, n010, n110), vec4(n001, n101, n011, n111), fade_xyz.z);\n    vec2 n_yz = mix(n_z.xy, n_z.zw, fade_xyz.y);\n    float n_xyz = mix(n_yz.x, n_yz.y, fade_xyz.x);\n    return 2.2 * n_xyz;\n}\n\nfloat turbulence(vec3 p) {\n    float w = 100.0;\n    float t = -.5;\n\n    for(float f = 1.0; f <= 10.0; f++) {\n        float power = pow(2.0, f);\n        t += abs(pnoise(vec3(power * p), vec3(10.0, 10.0, 10.0)) / power);\n    }\n\n    return t;\n}\n\nfloat turbulence3(vec3 p) {\n    float w = 100.0;\n    float t = -.5;\n\n    for(float f = 1.0; f <= 3.0; f++) {\n        float power = pow(2.0, f);\n        t += abs(pnoise(vec3(power * p), vec3(3.0, 3.0, 3.0)) / power);\n    }\n\n    return t;\n}\n\nfloat turbulence6(vec3 p) {\n    float w = 100.0;\n    float t = -.5;\n\n    for(float f = 1.0; f <= 6.0; f++) {\n        float power = pow(2.0, f);\n        t += abs(pnoise(vec3(power * p), vec3(6.0, 6.0, 6.0)) / power);\n    }\n\n    return t;\n}\n\n\t//\n\t// 2-D tiling simplex noise with rotating gradients and analytical derivative.\n\t// The first component of the 3-element return vector is the noise value,\n\t// and the second and third components are the x and y partial derivatives.\n\t//\nvec3 psrdnoise(vec2 pos, vec2 per, float rot) {\n\t  // Hack: offset y slightly to hide some rare artifacts\n    pos.y += 0.01;\n\t  // Skew to hexagonal grid\n    vec2 uv = vec2(pos.x + pos.y * 0.5, pos.y);\n\n    vec2 i0 = floor(uv);\n    vec2 f0 = fract(uv);\n\t  // Traversal order\n    vec2 i1 = (f0.x > f0.y) ? vec2(1.0, 0.0) : vec2(0.0, 1.0);\n\n\t  // Unskewed grid points in (x,y) space\n    vec2 p0 = vec2(i0.x - i0.y * 0.5, i0.y);\n    vec2 p1 = vec2(p0.x + i1.x - i1.y * 0.5, p0.y + i1.y);\n    vec2 p2 = vec2(p0.x + 0.5, p0.y + 1.0);\n\n\t  // Integer grid point indices in (u,v) space\n    i1 = i0 + i1;\n    vec2 i2 = i0 + vec2(1.0, 1.0);\n\n\t  // Vectors in unskewed (x,y) coordinates from\n\t  // each of the simplex corners to the evaluation point\n    vec2 d0 = pos - p0;\n    vec2 d1 = pos - p1;\n    vec2 d2 = pos - p2;\n\n\t  // Wrap i0, i1 and i2 to the desired period before gradient hashing:\n\t  // wrap points in (x,y), map to (u,v)\n    vec3 xw = mod(vec3(p0.x, p1.x, p2.x), per.x);\n    vec3 yw = mod(vec3(p0.y, p1.y, p2.y), per.y);\n    vec3 iuw = xw + 0.5 * yw;\n    vec3 ivw = yw;\n\n\t  // Create gradients from indices\n    vec2 g0 = rgrad2(vec2(iuw.x, ivw.x), rot);\n    vec2 g1 = rgrad2(vec2(iuw.y, ivw.y), rot);\n    vec2 g2 = rgrad2(vec2(iuw.z, ivw.z), rot);\n\n\t  // Gradients dot vectors to corresponding corners\n\t  // (The derivatives of this are simply the gradients)\n    vec3 w = vec3(dot(g0, d0), dot(g1, d1), dot(g2, d2));\n\n\t  // Radial weights from corners\n\t  // 0.8 is the square of 2/sqrt(5), the distance from\n\t  // a grid point to the nearest simplex boundary\n    vec3 t = 0.8 - vec3(dot(d0, d0), dot(d1, d1), dot(d2, d2));\n\n\t  // Partial derivatives for analytical gradient computation\n    vec3 dtdx = -2.0 * vec3(d0.x, d1.x, d2.x);\n    vec3 dtdy = -2.0 * vec3(d0.y, d1.y, d2.y);\n\n\t  // Set influence of each surflet to zero outside radius sqrt(0.8)\n    if(t.x < 0.0) {\n        dtdx.x = 0.0;\n        dtdy.x = 0.0;\n        t.x = 0.0;\n    }\n    if(t.y < 0.0) {\n        dtdx.y = 0.0;\n        dtdy.y = 0.0;\n        t.y = 0.0;\n    }\n    if(t.z < 0.0) {\n        dtdx.z = 0.0;\n        dtdy.z = 0.0;\n        t.z = 0.0;\n    }\n\n\t  // Fourth power of t (and third power for derivative)\n    vec3 t2 = t * t;\n    vec3 t4 = t2 * t2;\n    vec3 t3 = t2 * t;\n\n\t  // Final noise value is:\n\t  // sum of ((radial weights) times (gradient dot vector from corner))\n    float n = dot(t4, w);\n\n\t  // Final analytical derivative (gradient of a sum of scalar products)\n    vec2 dt0 = vec2(dtdx.x, dtdy.x) * 4.0 * t3.x;\n    vec2 dn0 = t4.x * g0 + dt0 * w.x;\n    vec2 dt1 = vec2(dtdx.y, dtdy.y) * 4.0 * t3.y;\n    vec2 dn1 = t4.y * g1 + dt1 * w.y;\n    vec2 dt2 = vec2(dtdx.z, dtdy.z) * 4.0 * t3.z;\n    vec2 dn2 = t4.z * g2 + dt2 * w.z;\n\n    return 11.0 * vec3(n, dn0 + dn1 + dn2);\n}\n\n\t//\n\t// 2-D tiling simplex noise with fixed gradients\n\t// and analytical derivative.\n\t// This function is implemented as a wrapper to \"psrdnoise\",\n\t// at the minimal cost of three extra additions.\n\t//\nvec3 psdnoise(vec2 pos, vec2 per) {\n    return psrdnoise(pos, per, 0.0);\n}\n\n\t//\n\t// 2-D tiling simplex noise with rotating gradients,\n\t// but without the analytical derivative.\n\t//\nfloat psrnoise(vec2 pos, vec2 per, float rot) {\n\t  // Offset y slightly to hide some rare artifacts\n    pos.y += const vertexShaderPromise = fetch('json/uniforms.json').then(response => response.json())\n        .then(data => {\n            uniforms = data.uniforms;\n            uniforms.u_tex.value = new THREE.TextureLoader().load(data.uniforms.u_tex.value);\n        });\n\n    return vertexShaderPromise;\n}\n\nfunction loadShaders() {\n    const vertexShaderPromise = fetch('glsl/vertexShader.glsl')\n        .then(response => response.text())\n        .then(data => {\n            vShader = data;\n        });\n\n    const fragmentShaderPromise = fetch('glsl/fragmentShader.glsl')\n        .then(response => response.text())\n        .then(data => {\n            fShader = data;\n        });\n\n    return Promise.all([vertexShaderPromise, fragmentShaderPromise]);\n}\n\nfunction main() {\n    scene = new THREE.Scene();\n    camera = new THREE.OrthographicCamera(-1, 1, 1, -1, 0.1, 10);\n\n    renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer();\n    renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);\n    document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);\n\n    clock = new THREE.Clock();\n    geometry = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(2, 2);\n\n    uniforms = {u_time: { value: 0 }};\n\n    loadUniforms().then(() => {\n        loadShaders().then(() => {\n            material = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({ uniforms: uniforms, vertexShader: vShader, fragmentShader: fShader });\n            plane = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, material);\n            scene.add(plane);\n        }).catch(error => console.error('Error loading shaders:', error));\n    }).catch(error => console.error('Error loading uniforms:', error));\n\n    camera.position.z = 1;\n\n    onWindowResize();\n    window.addEventListener('resize', onWindowResize, false);\n\n    animate();\n\n}\n\nfunction onWindowResize(event) {\n    const aspectRatio = window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight;\n    let width, height;\n    if (aspectRatio >= 1) {\n        width = 1;\n        height = (window.innerHeight / window.innerWidth) * width;\n    } else {\n        width = aspectRatio;\n        height = 1;\n    }\n    camera.left = -width;\n    camera.right = width;\n    camera.top = height;\n    camera.bottom = -height;\n    camera.updateProjectionMatrix();\n    renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);\n}\n\nfunction animate() {\n    requestAnimationFrame(animate);\n    uniforms.u_time.value += clock.getDelta();\n    renderer.render(scene, camera);\n}",

main() {\n    scene = new THREE.Scene();\n    camera = new THREE.OrthographicCamera(-1, 1, 1, -1, 0.1, 10);\n\n    renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer();\n    renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);\n    document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);\n\n    clock = new THREE.Clock();\n\n    geometry = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(2, 1.5);\n    uniforms = {\n        u_tex_1: { value: null },\n        u_tex_2: { value: null },\n        u_duration: { value: 2.0 },\n        u_time: { value: 0.0 },\n        u_mouse: { value: { x: 0.0, y: 0.0 } },\n        u_resolution: { value: { x: 0, y: 0 } }\n    }\n\n    loadShaders().then(() => {\n        material = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({ uniforms: uniforms, vertexShader: vShader, fragmentShader: fShader });\n        plane = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, material);\n        scene.add(plane);\n    }).catch(error => console.error('Error loading shaders:', error));\n\n    camera.position.z = 1;\n\n    onWindowResize();\n    if ('ontouchstart' in window) {\n        document.addEventListener('touchmove', move);\n    } else {\n        window.addEventListener('resize', onWindowResize, false);\n        document.addEventListener('mousemove', move);\n    }\n\n\n\n    index = 0;\n    images = [];\n    loader = new THREE.TextureLoader();\n    loader.setPath('https://s3-us-west-2.amazonaws.com/s.cdpn.io/2666677/');\n    loadNextImage(loader);\n}\n\nfunction loadShaders() {\n    const vertexShaderPromise = fetch('glsl/vertexShader.glsl')\n        .then(response => response.text())\n        .then(data => {\n            vShader = data;\n        });\n \n    const fragmentShaderPromise = fetch('glsl/fragmentShader.glsl')\n        .then(response => response.text())\n        .then(data => {\n            fShader = data;\n        });\n \n    return Promise.all([vertexShaderPromise, fragmentShaderPromise]);\n}\n\nfunction loadNextImage(loader) {\n    index++;\n    if (index > 5) {\n        index = 0;\n        uniforms.u_tex_1.value = images[0];\n        uniforms.u_tex_2.value = images[1];\n        uniforms.u_time.value = 0;\n\n        const prev = document.getElementById(\"prev\");\n\n        prev.onclick = function () {\n            uniforms.u_time.value = 0;\n\n            if (index == 4) {\n                uniforms.u_tex_1.value = images[0];\n                uniforms.u_tex_2.value = images[4];\n            } else if (index < 0) {\n                index = 4;\n                uniforms.u_tex_1.value = images[0];\n                uniforms.u_tex_2.value = images[4];\n            } else {\n                uniforms.u_tex_1.value = images[index + 1];\n                uniforms.u_tex_2.value = images[index];\n            }\n            const msg = document.getElementById(\"msg\");\n            msg.style.display = \"none\";\n            index--;\n        };\n\n        const next = document.getElementById(\"next\");\n\n        next.onclick = function () {\n            uniforms.u_time.value = 0;\n\n            index++;\n            if (index >= 5) {\n                index = 0;\n                uniforms.u_tex_1.value = images[0];\n                uniforms.u_tex_2.value = images[1];\n            } else if (index == 4) {\n                uniforms.u_tex_1.value = images[4];\n                uniforms.u_tex_2.value = images[0];\n            } else {\n                uniforms.u_tex_1.value = images[index];\n                uniforms.u_tex_2.value = images[index + 1];\n            }\n            const msg = document.getElementById(\"msg\");\n            msg.style.display = \"none\";\n        };\n\n        animate();\n    } else {\n        loader.load(`sa${index}.jpg`, function (tex) {\n            images.push(tex);\n            loadNextImage(loader);\n        })\n    }\n}\n\n\nfunction move(evt) {\n    uniforms.u_mouse.value.x = (evt.touches) ? evt.touches[0].clientX : evt.clientX;\n    uniforms.u_mouse.value.y = (evt.touches) ? evt.touches[0].clientY : evt.clientY;\n}\n\nfunction onWindowResize(event) {\n    const aspectRatio = window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight;\n    let width, height;\n    if (aspectRatio >= (2 / 1.5)) {\n        console.log(\"resize: Use width\");\n        width = 1;\n        height = (window.innerHeight / window.innerWidth) * width;\n    } else {\n        console.log(\"resize: Use height\")\n        height = 1.5 / 2;\n        width = (window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight) * height;\n    }\n    camera.left = -width;\n    camera.right = width;\n    camera.top = height;\n    camera.bottom = -height;\n    camera.updateProjectionMatrix();\n    renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);\n    uniforms.u_resolution.value.x = window.innerWidth;\n    uniforms.u_resolution.value.y = window.innerHeight;\n}\n\nfunction animate() {\n    requestAnimationFrame(animate);\n    const delta = clock.getDelta();\n    if (uniforms.u_time.value < uniforms.u_duration.value) {\n        uniforms.u_time.value += delta;\n    } else {\n        uniforms.u_time.value = uniforms.u_duration.value;\n    }\n    renderer.render(scene, camera);\n}",

evt.touches[0].clientX : evt.clientX;\n            uniforms.u_mouse.value.y = (evt.touches) ? evt.touches[0].clientY : evt.clientY;\n        }\n\n        animate();\n    }).catch(error => console.error('Error loading shaders:', error));\n}\n\nfunction loadShaders() {\n    const vertexShaderPromise = fetch('glsl/vertexShader.glsl')\n        .then(response => response.text())\n        .then(data => {\n            vShader = data;\n        });\n\n    const fragmentShaderPromise = fetch('glsl/fragmentShader.glsl')\n        .then(response => response.text())\n        .then(data => {\n            fShader = data;\n        });\n\n    return Promise.all([vertexShaderPromise, fragmentShaderPromise]);\n}\n\nfunction onWindowResize(event) {\n    camera.aspect = window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight;\n    camera.updateProjectionMatrix();\n    renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);\n    uniforms.u_resolution.value.x = window.innerWidth;\n    uniforms.u_resolution.value.y = window.innerHeight;\n}\n\nfunction animate() {\n    requestAnimationFrame(animate);\n    uniforms.u_time.value += clock.getDelta();\n    renderer.render(scene, camera);\n}",
